adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, the blacklist is normalized to lowercase (`BLACKLISTED_GUEST_EMAILS.split(...).map(email => email.toLowerCase())`), but the submitted `guest` strings are compared without normalization: `!blacklistedGuestEmails.includes(guest)`. Since `guests` comes from input (`z.array(z.string().email())`) and is not lowercased in the handler, a mixed/upper-cased email like `Spam@Example.com` will not match a lowercased blacklist entry (`spam@example.com`) and will pass the filter, effectively bypassing the blacklist.
